The description correctly assigns (72.7, 63.3) to Hungary, but then incorrectly also associates the values (72.4, 59.5) with Hungary. The label (72.4, 59.5) in the figure corresponds to the light blue line for Slovakia.
The description does not mention the colors used for each country (e.g., Poland is grey, Hungary is orange, etc.). It only mentions the colors when describing the individual lines.
